# Noisemaker Vendor Files

This directory contains the vendored Noisemaker shaders bundle.

## Updating

Run the pull-noisemaker script from the project root:

```bash
./pull-noisemaker
```

This will:
1. Clone the noisemaker repository
2. Build the ESM bundles
3. Copy the bundles and effects to this directory

## Contents (after running pull-noisemaker)

- `noisemaker-shaders-core.esm.js` - Full bundle for local development
- `noisemaker-shaders-core.esm.min.js` - Minified bundle for production
- `effects/` - Pre-built effect bundles with inlined shaders
- `effects/manifest.json` - Effect metadata

## Note

Do not edit files in this directory manually. They are generated by
the upstream noisemaker build process.
